description: kevinliu.studio, Kevin Liu's personal site: 26 of his software projects shown as collectible cards, plus a turn-based card battle. Terse, plain, factual voice. Keep product names, people's and company names, move names in {move}, code, file paths and URLs exactly as written. 'Type' as a discipline means typography and type design. 'Inks' are the cost unit a card spends in a team. 'Kit' is the battle's item bag. 'Mat' and 'Arena' are the two battle modes. Machine view and Human view are the site's two ways of reading a page.
